sentences.en: She has consented to take the leadership of the party.
sentences.zh: 她同意担任该党的领导人。

sentences.en: Leadership by coercion would not produce the results we see.
sentences.zh: 靠强制手段进行领导不会取得我们所看到的结果。

sentences.en: Certainly there are downsides to leadership by coercion and force.
sentences.zh: 当然，强制性领导也有其不利的一面。

senses.zh: 领导力，领导能力；领导地位，领导职位；领导层，领导人员
